content: The product contains bacterial spores from Firmicutes, with a concentration of 1 x 10^6 to 3 x 10^7 colony-forming units per capsule. It is specifically indicated for the prevention of recurrent Clostridioides difficile infection (rCDI) in adults who have completed antibacterial treatment for recurrent CDI. The recommended dosage is four capsules taken orally once daily for three consecutive days. Prior to the first dose, patient preparation instructions should be followed as outlined in the administration guidelines. This product is not intended for the treatment of active CDI, and its safety and efficacy for this purpose have not been established. Antibacterial agents, such as amikacin, amoxicillin, and others, may reduce the effectiveness of the microbiota oral product due to pharmacodynamic antagonism. It is advised to avoid co-administration of these agents or consider alternative drugs. The microbiota oral product contains bacterial spores, and its efficacy may be compromised if administered concurrently with antibacterial agents. To optimize effectiveness, complete the full course of antibiotics 2 to 4 days before initiating the microbiota oral product. This interaction applies to a wide range of antibiotics, including but not limited to azithromycin, ceftriaxone, ciprofloxacin, clindamycin, doxycycline, and meropenem. For each of these agents, the recommendation remains to avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug, ensuring that the antibiotic regimen is completed 2 to 4 days prior to starting the microbiota oral product.
